Resolves #3762

Passes `Store` (`Neo.data.Store`) as `DefaultClass` in `Neo.state.Provider#beforeSetStores` (`ClassSystemUtil.beforeSetInstance(storeValue, Store)`) so inline `stores` entries that omit `module`, `className`, and `ntype` instantiate `Neo.data.Store` by default instead of failing `Neo.create` validation and resolving to `null`. Guards `Neo.util.ClassSystem.beforeSetInstance` (`if (DefaultClass && !config.className)`) so store configs specifying `className` do not also receive `module: DefaultClass`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/state/Provider.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (unit verification of default `Neo.data.Store` instantiation and `className` precedence in `StateProvider#stores`).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/state/Provider.spec.mjs` (`Store entries without module, className, or ntype default to Neo.data.Store`) |

## Deltas from ticket
Added `!config.className` guard in `Neo.util.ClassSystem.beforeSetInstance` (`src/util/ClassSystem.mjs`) so a `stores` entry configured with `className` (without `module`) is not assigned `module: DefaultClass` alongside `className`.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required; covered by unit tests in CI.
